Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

## Summary

**Issue:** `checkout-api` was failing health checks after the latest deploy of **v2.3.1** (unhealthy, error rate 0.18) across all production regions.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** the service status and deployment history. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.2.9 was older/healthy but not the most recent).
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially completed (us-east only) due to an orchestrator error, so I retried and the rollback completed successfully — all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on **v2.3.0**.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0002) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback. The first attempt timed out, so I retried and it succeeded, paging the on-call engineer.

**Final state:** `checkout-api` is on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** (error rate 0.002). Incident INC-0002 is open and tracked.
